report.title: Service Center Report
report.ask.1: Experience with this specific chipset and storage class.
report.ask.2: Infrared soldering station (not a heat gun) with a stencil matching this UFS/eMMC package.
report.ask.4: Readiness to replace UFS/CPU if chip-off fails (price upfront).
report.ask.5: If possible — ISP instead of chip-off (less risk, but often unavailable on new Xiaomi).
report.footer: Generated by Pandora Unified · Full recovery journal:
tip.diagnostic: Read all fastboot getvar + OEM state and save a JSON report. [F1]
tip.ufs_check: Detect UFS storage vendor from `variant`. Critical for auth-free firehose compatibility. [F2]
tip.bootfail: Parse a captured .bin bootfail dump for errors, versions, boot reasons. [F3]
tip.compare: Verify current partition sizes against a known-good OTA zip. [F4]
tip.reports: Open the unified_reports/ folder with past diagnostics and snapshots. [F5]
tip.lock_wizard: Show the correct bootloader lock sequence for your unlock method. The main value of this tool. [F6]
tip.snapshot: Backup getvar + OEM + dynamic token to a zip. Run BEFORE any risky operation. [F7]
tip.service_report: Generate a self-contained HTML report for a repair technician. [F8]
tip.ufs_health: ADB dd read/write benchmark. First run saves a baseline, later runs compare and warn if degraded. [F9]
tip.lessons: Open LESSONS_LEARNED.md with the mistake-prevention playbook. [F10]
tip.log.support: Export full support bundle (log + state + reports) as a zip
